item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:40 AM 13 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(SanAntonio, Capul and SanVicente) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Biri, Lavezares, Rosario, Allen, Victoria), #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza, Cataingan and Placer) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
